strategy_layer4_mupost_chase.role: L4 chase posture: priced mu_post + λ·z(upside semi-SD from fixture-cov draws); always-on stress test
strategy_layer4_mupost_chase.decision_mu: mu_dec = mu_post + λ · z(upside_semi_sd); within-position z
strategy_layer4_mupost_chase.upside_semi_sd: sqrt(E[(xp−μ)_+²]) from fixture_covariance draws; RSS over DGW fixtures
strategy_layer4_mupost_chase.posture: chase always-on (no rank schedule this arm)
strategy_layer4_mupost_chase.covariance: upside risk only — never replaces mu_post
strategy_layer4_mupost_chase.eval: paired-by-GW realised XI+captain-hits on four closed seasons

strategy_layer4_mupost_posture.role: L4 adaptive λ from as-of cumulative gap vs shadow L3; chase/consolidate/neutral
strategy_layer4_mupost_posture.gap: L3_cum(t-1) − L4_adapt_cum(t-1); no same-week realised points
strategy_layer4_mupost_posture.eval: paired-by-GW realised XI+captain-hits; adapt−L3 and adapt−exp on four closed seasons

strategy_layer4_mupost_chase_behind.role: L4 adaptive chase-only when behind L3; neutral when ahead (no consolidate)
strategy_layer4_mupost_chase_behind.gap: L3_cum(t-1) − L4_adapt_cum(t-1); no same-week realised points
strategy_layer4_mupost_chase_behind.decision_mu: mu_dec = mu_post + λ_chase·z(upside_semi_sd) when behind; else mu_post
strategy_layer4_mupost_chase_behind.eval: paired-by-GW realised XI+captain-hits; adapt−L3 and adapt−exp on four closed seasons

note: Gaussian log score with sigma fixed at 3. The bootstrap resamples gameweeks, not player rows. 2026-27 is not in the closed-season comparison. Gameweeks 1-5 of that season were already read. The clean holdout starts at gameweek 6. A season total is not a pass. The decision batch scores score_xp. From gameweek 6 the live choice primary is ep_next and score_xp is logged as the shadow. Promotion needs the paired interval of score_xp minus ep_next to stay strictly above zero on at least 20 pre-deadline weeks. An interval that covers zero is undetermined, and the test continues through gameweek 38. From gameweek 6 the live squad is chosen by captured ep_next. score_xp is logged in shadow and does not choose. The historical score column stays score_xp. The eligible pool is the primary closed-season result and the all-weeks pool is the sensitivity. The decision capture is the same-stamp pair from the window three hours to fifteen minutes before the deadline. An earlier file is not a fallback. The Gameweek 6 chip is a logged wildcard judgement. It preceded the capture and does not count toward a chip rule. An injury flag is the minutes file, and a written zero stays zero. A manual override is a log entry that names the player, the value, and the reason. The review is at gameweek 26.
